items.title: Falcons' Pearce suspended 8 games after arrest
items.description: Falcons edge rusher James Pearce Jr. will be suspended by the NFL for eight games due to violating the league's personal conduct policy, the league announced Friday afternoon.

items.title: Jadarian Price: Won't play Saturday
items.description:
Price (lower body) won't suit up for Saturday's preseason game against the Cowboys, Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Aikman gets Brady-like limits for MNF broadcasts
items.description: ESPN analyst Troy Aikman will see some restrictions in the lead-up to "Monday Night Football" broadcasts similar to those for Fox's Tom Brady.

items.title: Josh Jacobs: May return to practice soon
items.description:
Coach Matt LaFleur said Friday that Jacobs (groin) could potentially return to practice later next week, Weston Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Commanders' Armstrong suspended for opener
items.description: Commanders defensive end/linebacker Dorance Armstrong has been suspended without pay for the season opener for violating the NFL's personal conduct policy.

items.title: James Pearce: Facing eight-game suspension
items.description:
The NFL suspended Pearce eight games Friday for violating the league's personal conduct policy, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Bills DT Mathis suspended 3 games by NFL
items.description: Bills defensive tackle Phidarian Mathis has been suspended for the first three games of the season for violating the NFL's substance abuse policy.

items.title: Jordyn Tyson: Injury timetable TBD, could impact Week 1 status
items.description:
Coach Kellen Moore acknowledged that Tyson's right hamstring injury "could" linger into the start of the regular season, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Saints WR Tyson to miss time due to hamstring
items.description: Saints rookie wide receiver Jordyn Tyson has a right hamstring issue and will miss time, according to Saints coach Kellen Moore.

items.title: Jordyn Tyson: Hamstring injury confirmed by coach
items.description:
Coach Kellen Moore confirmed Friday that Tyson is dealing with a right hamstring injury, Luke Johnson of The New Orleans Times-Picayune reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kubiak's plan: More 1st-team reps for all 3 QBs
items.description: Raiders coach Klint Kubiak says rookie quarterback Fernando Mendoza played "good football" in his preseason debut, adding that all three signal-callers deserve more first-team reps.

items.title: 'Poised' QBs Allar, Howard lead Steelers in win
items.description: Steelers rookie quarterbacks Drew Allar and Will Howard turned in solid performances during a 28-9 preseason win over the Packers.
